title: REQ · Mounted admin round routes answer with exact handler statuses for a Bearer admin token
summary: server.New mounts admin round routes and they return 200, 404 and 400 as the handlers define
description: Context: adminRoundRoutes is mounted by New behind admin.Middleware. Desired behavior: with Authorization Bearer tok, GET round answers 200, an unknown round answers 404, and POST /rounds with invalid JSON answers 400. Expected result: tests fail if a route is unmounted or middleware swallows the request. Why: != 404 does not prove the handler ran.
acceptance_criteria: Given a server with an on-disk round-0000001, when GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001?world=the-boys-room has Bearer tok, then status is 200 and body id is ROUND-0000001
Given an unknown round id, when GET with Bearer tok, then status is 404 with body not equal to the chi default 404 page
Given invalid JSON, when POST /api/v1/admin/rounds has Bearer tok, then status is 400 with body invalid json

out_of_scope: Opening or closing rounds through real Git

technical_constraints: Reuse adminRoundRoutes; do not add routes
definition_of_done: Routes confirmed mounted exactly as in adminRoundRoutes
